# Pixenox

> PIXENOX SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED (CIN: U62091AP2026PTC125091) is an India-based AI systems and enterprise software engineering company building production multi-agent AI systems, non-disruptive enterprise intelligence platforms, AI visibility (GEO/AEO) infrastructure, and proprietary software products including Engenox and Unool.

## Official Identity
- Legal Entity: PIXENOX SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED
- Incorporated: April 2, 2026 (RoC-Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, India)
- Founders & Directors: Muchakarla Sai Charan, Jagatha Hemanth Sai Ram
- Canonical Website: https://www.pixenox.com
- Contact Email: connect@pixenox.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/pixenox-solutions-pvt/
- X (Twitter): https://x.com/pixenox

## Core Engineering Disciplines
- [Engineering Capabilities Hub](https://www.pixenox.com/engineering): Overview of Pixenox's three core enterprise engineering disciplines.
- [Production AI Systems Engineering](https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/ai-systems): Governed multi-agent workflows, deterministic guardrails, decision intelligence engines, and production AI infrastructure.
- [AI Visibility Engineering — GEO & AEO](https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/ai-visibility): Technical Generative Engine Optimization, Answer Engine Optimization, SSR crawler readiness, Schema.org entity graphs, and AI citation telemetry.
- [Enterprise Intelligence Engineering](https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/enterprise-intelligence-engineering): Non-disruptive ERP, CRM, and cloud data unification using CDC pipelines, governed semantic layers, and decision intelligence platforms.

## Proprietary Products Built by Pixenox
- [Engenox by Pixenox](https://www.pixenox.com/products/engenox): Unified autonomous SEO, GEO, and AEO operating system for crawl governance, entity graphs, structured publishing, and AI citation monitoring.
- [Unool](https://unool.co): One Link + One Click social publishing and creator distribution platform built by Pixenox Solutions.
